tools.name: crosswalk_resolve_company
tools.description: Find a company's LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, or YouTube from its website or business name. Confirms the profile belongs to that company. Use to enrich lead lists and Google Maps scrapes. Companies and orgs only — not people.

input.description: Paid sample inputs documented in x_sample_paid_inputs

tools.x_when_to_use: Verified organization LinkedIn/Instagram/Facebook/X/TikTok/YouTube from website or company name. Platform confirms the link. Orgs only; never people. Confidence + evidence. Dataset enrich via inputDatasetId.

tools.name: eu_ted_notices_search
tools.description: Find European Union government contracts and public tenders. Search by keyword, country, or industry to spot EU bids worth pursuing.

input.description: Paid sample inputs documented in x_sample_paid_inputs

tools.x_when_to_use: EU public procurement notices from official TED Search API v3 (anonymous, no API key).

tools.x_when_to_use: US federal contract/IDV awards from official USASpending.gov v2 with agency, recipient, or NAICS filters.
